depiction.primary_object: horizontal double-headed arrow pointing left and right
depiction.composition: single centered horizontal shaft with arrowheads at both ends

readings.meaning: swap, exchange, or trade between two things
compare two options side by side

ambiguity: Easily confused with a two-arrow swap/exchange icon, a ruler/measurement icon for width, or generic UI resize chrome.
task_intents: swap shifts or dates with someone
compare two competing quotes or plans

Transfer photos back and forth between the old laptop and external drive to deduplicate

reasoning: A single horizontal double-headed arrow is an abstract UI glyph for horizontal resizing, span, or bidirectional movement rather than a concrete object. While it can loosely suggest swapping, syncing, or measuring width, dedicated icons (two opposing arrows for swap/transfer, a ruler/tape measure for dimensions) cue those tasks much more clearly.
